title: Sick Visits on the Day of a Well-Child Visit
content:
**Medicaid Managed Care Membership — pediatric care coding guidance**

When primary care office visits are re-rated as preventive or coordinated care, a sick visit held on the same day as a well-child visit is treated as part of that preventive visit.

## Guidance

A sick visit the primary care visit log records on the same day as the latest logged well-child visit folds into it and re-rates at:

- **0.00 USD**, the medical-home same-day copay, when the member's current practice is a Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice or Federally Qualified Health Center Home;
- **2.50 USD**, the other-practice same-day copay, when the current practice is of any other type.

Where no sick visit shares that day, nothing is re-rated under this guidance.

The day tested is the date of the latest well-child visit logged in the member's primary care visit records (Primary Care Provider Assignment), and every sick visit logged on exactly that date is re-rated. The current practice type is that of the member's active assignment.

## Input, judgement, result

| Input | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Date of the latest logged well-child visit | Is any sick visit logged on that same date? | No: nothing re-rated under this guidance |
| Sick visits logged on that date: one or more | Current practice a medical home (Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice or Federally Qualified Health Center Home)? | Yes: each such sick visit re-rates at 0.00 |
| | | No: each such sick visit re-rates at 2.50 |

## Hypothetical cases

Dates chosen for illustration only.

- Latest well-child visit logged on 12 June; a sick visit is logged on 12 June; the current practice is a Pediatric Primary Care Provider. The sick visit re-rates at 2.50.
- Same, with the current practice a Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice: re-rated at 0.00.
- Latest well-child visit on 12 June; the only sick visits are logged on 11 June and 13 June. No sick visit shares the day; nothing is re-rated under this guidance.
- An earlier well-child visit on 3 February has a sick visit on the same day, and the latest well-child visit is 12 June with no sick visit that day. Only the latest well-child visit's day is tested, so nothing is re-rated under this guidance.
